ATL.name: Jock Landale
ATL.comment: Landale (hip) is out for Friday's game against the Celtics.

ATL.name: Asa Newell
ATL.comment: Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: CJ McCollum
ATL.comment: McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

ATL.name: Mouhamed Gueye
ATL.comment: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

ATL.name: Henri Veesaar
ATL.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

BOS.name: Mitchell Robinson
BOS.comment: Robinson has been ruled out Marc D'Amico of the Celtics' official sitefor Friday's game.

BKN.name: Moritz Wagner
BKN.comment: Wagner (knee) won't be available for Friday's game against Toronto.

BKN.name: Nolan Traore
BKN.comment: Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

CHA.name: Grayson Allen
CHA.comment: Allen (concussion) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Nets.

CHA.name: Ryan Kalkbrenner
CHA.comment: Kalkbrenner (hip) is probable for Saturday's matchup with Brooklyn.

CHA.name: Dennis Schroder
CHA.comment: Schroder (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game the Bulls.

CHA.name: Kon Knueppel
CHA.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

CHI.name: Norman Powell
CHI.comment: Powell (hamstring) is out for Saturday's game against the Pacers.

CHI.name: Noa Essengue
CHI.comment: Essengue (thumb) is probable to play Saturday against the Pacers.

CHI.name: Jalen Smith
CHI.comment: Smith (illness) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against Indiana.

CHI.name: Caleb Wilson
CHI.comment: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

CLE.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
CLE.comment: Tomlin (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.

CLE.name: Evan Mobley
CLE.comment: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.

DAL.name: Caleb Martin
DAL.comment: Martin didn't return for the second half of Friday's win over the Suns due to a left ankle sprain, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.

DAL.name: Kyrie Irving
DAL.comment: Irving (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Suns, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reports.

DAL.name: Tobi Lawal
DAL.comment: Lawal (groin) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

DAL.name: Sergio de Larrea
DAL.comment: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

DAL.name: Dereck Lively II
DAL.comment: Lively (foot) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

DAL.name: Tarik Biberovic
DAL.comment: Biberovic (heel) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

DET.name: Duncan Robinson
DET.comment: Robinson (quadriceps) is out for Friday's game against the Bucks.

DET.name: Cade Cunningham
DET.comment: Cunningham (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Bucks.

DET.name: Jalen Duren
DET.comment: Detroit recalled Duren (hamstring) from the G League's Motor City Cruise on Wednesday.

DET.name: Ebuka Okorie
DET.comment: The Pistons announced Tuesday that Okorie (oblique) will miss at least two weeks, per Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com.

DET.name: Taurean Prince
DET.comment: Prince underwent arthroscopic right knee surgery Nov. 18 and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

GS.name: Gui Santos
GS.comment: Santos exited Friday's game against the Trail Blazers with a knee injury in the second half and won't return.

GS.name: Stephen Curry
GS.comment: Curry (abdomen/oblique) has been ruled out for each of the Warriors' next three games, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports

GS.name: Kristaps Porzingis
GS.comment: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

GS.name: Moses Moody
GS.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

GS.name: Jimmy Butler III
GS.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

HOU.name: Steven Adams
HOU.comment: Adams (knee) is questionable for Saturday's game against the 76ers.

IND.name: Tyrese Haliburton
IND.comment: The Pacers recalled Haliburton (hamstring) from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Friday, per the NBA G League transaction report.

IND.name: T.J. McConnell
IND.comment: McConnell (hamstring) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the 76ers, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

IND.name: Ben Sheppard
IND.comment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

LAC.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
LAC.comment: Niederhauser suffered a right toe injury during Friday's game against the Pelicans and won't return, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.

LAC.name: Bradley Beal
LAC.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

LAC.name: Jordan Miller
LAC.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

MEM.name: Isaiah Stewart
MEM.comment: Stewart (hip) is out for Friday's game against the Timberwolves, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

MEM.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
MEM.comment: Pippen (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

MEM.name: Cameron Boozer
MEM.comment: Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

MEM.name: Jerami Grant
MEM.comment: Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.

MEM.name: GG Jackson
MEM.comment: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.

MEM.name: Richie Saunders
MEM.comment: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

MIL.name: Kasparas Jakucionis
MIL.comment: Jakucionis (ankle) won't play Friday's game against the Pistons.

MIN.name: LaMelo Ball
MIN.comment: Ball (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies. The guard was previously questionable after spraining his left ankle during Wednesday's win over Oklahoma City.

MIN.name: Donte DiVincenzo
MIN.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) has been cleared for team basketball activities and is targeting a return to game action in January, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

MIN.name: Jaylen Clark
MIN.comment: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

MIN.name: Anthony Edwards
MIN.comment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

NO.name: Bennedict Mathurin
NO.comment: Mathurin (foot) is out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

NO.name: Julian Reese
NO.comment: The Pelicans transferred Reese from the G League's Laketown Squadron, and he will be available for New Orleans' game against the Warriors on Monday.

NO.name: Dejounte Murray
NO.comment: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

NY.name: Miles McBride
NY.comment: McBride (groin) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

NY.name: OG Anunoby
NY.comment: Anunoby (calf) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Heat. The forward was previously listed as doubtful and will miss his third consecutive contest due to a left calf strain.

NY.name: Jordan Clarkson
NY.comment: Clarkson (foot) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

NY.name: Andre Drummond
NY.comment: Drummond (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Heat.

OKC.name: Nikola Topic
OKC.comment: Topic (hip) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.

OKC.name: Aday Mara
OKC.comment: Mara (leg) is out for Saturday's game versus the Bucks, per Clemente Almanza of USA Today.

OKC.name: Jaylin Williams
OKC.comment: Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.

OKC.name: Jalen Williams
OKC.comment: Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

OKC.name: Thomas Sorber
OKC.comment: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks, Steve McGehee of News 9 Oklahoma City reports.

OKC.name: Cason Wallace
OKC.comment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

OKC.name: Chet Holmgren
OKC.comment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

ORL.name: Colin Castleton
ORL.comment: Castleton totaled five points (2-4 FG, 1-1 3Pt) and four rebounds in seven minutes during Tuesday's 132-116 preseason win over the Cavaliers.

ORL.name: Kevin Porter Jr.
ORL.comment: Porter won't play Saturday against the Wizards as he's still in the process of getting up to speed on his conditioning.

ORL.name: Anthony Black
ORL.comment: Black (back) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Wizards.

ORL.name: Jonathan Isaac
ORL.comment: Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.

ORL.name: Izaiyah Nelson
ORL.comment: Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal," Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

ORL.name: Noah Penda
ORL.comment: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

ORL.name: Paolo Banchero
ORL.comment: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

PHI.name: Dean Wade
PHI.comment: Wade (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Pacers, Austin Krell of Vertical 76 reports.

PHI.name: Joel Embiid
PHI.comment: Embiid has been ruled out for Saturday's game against the Rockets due to right foot plantar fasciitis management, Kris Rhim of ESPN.com reports.

PHI.name: LeBron James
PHI.comment: James (back injury management) won't be available for Saturday's game against the Rockets, according to Kris Rhim of ESPN.

PHI.name: Jaylen Brown
PHI.comment: Brown (hamstring) underwent an MRI that showed no signs of a new injury or re-aggravation, but he didn't travel with the team for the road trip, so he will miss the team's next two games, Kris Rhim of ESPN reports.

PHI.name: Ariel Hukporti
PHI.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

PHX.name: Mark Williams
PHX.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

POR.name: Damian Lillard
POR.comment: Lillard (calf) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors. The veteran guard is dealing with right calf tightness and soreness.

POR.name: Chris Youngblood
POR.comment: Youngblood (heel) is out for Friday's game against the Warriors.

POR.name: Vit Krejci
POR.comment: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

POR.name: Ja Morant
POR.comment: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

POR.name: Shaedon Sharpe
POR.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

SAC.name: Zach LaVine
SAC.comment: LaVine (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus the Warriors.

SAC.name: Maxime Raynaud
SAC.comment: Raynaud (knee) was recalled from the G League's Stockton Kings on Wednesday, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.

SAC.name: Ben Simmons
SAC.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

SA.name: Tobias Harris
SA.comment: Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December, per Jeff Garcia of KENS 5 San Antonio.

SA.name: Jayden Quaintance
SA.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

TOR.name: Ja'Kobe Walter
TOR.comment: Walter won't return to Friday's game against Brooklyn due to a right quad contusion, Josh Lewenberg of TSN.ca reports.

TOR.name: Kawhi Leonard
TOR.comment: Leonard has begun individual on-court workouts following treatment to address swelling in his left knee, and he will be re-evaluated in one week, Marc J. Spears of ESPN.com reports.

TOR.name: Nate Bittle
TOR.comment: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bucks, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

TOR.name: RJ Barrett
TOR.comment: Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

UTAH.name: Mo Bamba
UTAH.comment: Bamba (illness) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Nuggets.

UTAH.name: Lauri Markkanen
UTAH.comment: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

UTAH.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
UTAH.comment: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

WSH.name: Tristan Vukcevic
WSH.comment: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Boston.

WSH.name: Reece Beekman
WSH.comment: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

WSH.name: Justin Champagnie
WSH.comment: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

WSH.name: Jamir Watkins
WSH.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
